# SvgDocumentExport

<!-- Generated from the doc comments in the library. Do not edit this file. -->

A rendered SVG document: one standalone SVG string per page, plus `@font-face` CSS that embeds (as subsetted data URIs) the fonts the document used, so a host can render the pages with the exact fonts BonniePDF laid them out with.

Namespace `BonniePDF`.

## Constructors

```csharp
new SvgDocumentExport(IReadOnlyList<string> pages, string fontFaceCss, LayoutSnapshot snapshot = null, ComplianceReport report = null)
```

## Properties

- [`CurrentVersion`](#currentversion): The version of the export format, written as `version`.
- [`FontFaceCss`](#fontfacecss): `<style>`-ready `@font-face` rules, or `""` when the document uses no embeddable fonts (e.g. only the viewer-supplied standard-14).
- [`Pages`](#pages): One standalone SVG string per page, in page order.
- [`Report`](#report): The compliance report for `Snapshot`, present exactly when the snapshot is.
- [`Snapshot`](#snapshot): The captured layout tree, present only when `CaptureLayout` was set.
- [`Version`](#version): The export format version; see `CurrentVersion`.

### `CurrentVersion`

```csharp
static int CurrentVersion { get; }
```

*static, read-only*

The version of the export format, written as `version`. It changes only for a breaking change to the export's shape; the embedded snapshot carries its own version.

### `FontFaceCss`

```csharp
string FontFaceCss { get; }
```

*read-only*

`<style>`-ready `@font-face` rules, or `""` when the document uses no embeddable fonts (e.g. only the viewer-supplied standard-14).

### `Pages`

```csharp
IReadOnlyList<string> Pages { get; }
```

*read-only*

One standalone SVG string per page, in page order. Each root carries `width`, `height` and `viewBox` in PDF points.

> A read-only list: read it or loop over it, but it has no `add` or `push`.

### `Report`

```csharp
ComplianceReport Report { get; }
```

*read-only*

The compliance report for `Snapshot`, present exactly when the snapshot is. Equal to `Evaluate` with default options, so every rule family runs, WCAG included; filter by `Standard` to hide one. Attached here so the report always comes from the same engine as the snapshot it describes, even when it is read in another process.

### `Snapshot`

```csharp
LayoutSnapshot Snapshot { get; }
```

*read-only*

The captured layout tree, present only when `CaptureLayout` was set. Its pages and rectangles are index-aligned with `Pages` and use the same top-left, points coordinate space as the SVG.

### `Version`

```csharp
int Version { get; }
```

*read-only*

The export format version; see `CurrentVersion`.

## Methods

- [`ToJson`](#tojson): Writes the export as JSON: camelCase keys, unset values omitted rather than written as `null`, severities as `"error"` / `"warning"` / `"info"`.

### `ToJson`

```csharp
string ToJson()
```

Writes the export as JSON: camelCase keys, unset values omitted rather than written as `null`, severities as `"error"` / `"warning"` / `"info"`. A browser previewer loads the result directly, for example from an HTTP response.
